findings.description: Validation rules inlined verbatim in both data-ingestion prompts instead of referencing skills/data-validation-rules.md; evidence quality and exclusion transparency rules also inlined in step5-scoring.md instead of referencing their skill files. Skill files exist but are never read by any prompt.

Salary handoff offer is lost when user declines the reality check: step5-scoring.md's salary offer is conditional on 'if user does not ask about step 6', but in orchestrated mode the orchestrator (not the user) issues that question. If user declines step 6, step6's salary offer never runs and step5's conditional is ambiguous.
Version field in CLAUDE.md shows 0.4.2 but plugin.json and the latest release commit (a4adafe) show 0.5.0.

README, plugin.json, marketplace.json, and _config.yml describe this as a 'Claude Cowork plugin' while CLAUDE.md calls it a 'Claude Code plugin'. Confirmed intentional — Cowork is the workspace product name.
README says subagents are 'automatically routed' but both commands ask the user at each step whether to use Opus. Misleads new users about expected interaction.

SC step2 stored salary data only in session memory with no file write — unlike CF step4 which writes cf-step4-country-data.md. SC step4 referenced 'salary data stored in Step 2' relying on in-session state. Context compression between steps silently lost all ingested salary data with no recovery path.

README usage table missing Portal Finder; 'Both commands' text stale (three now exist); Salary Calculator row had stale 'scoped to a single country handed off from Country Finder' note after handoff feature was removed.
CLAUDE.md purpose line said 'Two slash commands' after Portal Finder was added; architecture table missing portal-finder command and prompt entries.
Portal Finder step1 ended with 'Your job is done — stop.' while all other step prompts end with 'Step complete — stop here and wait for the main command.' Inconsistent termination language.

SC step5 opened with 'I already: 1. Researched... 2. Estimated... 3. Generated...' — stale first-person context framing written before file persistence was added. Step5 now reads from sc-step4-salary-table.md; the preamble added no instruction value.

Step framed as automated ('no user input is needed') but instructed to 'stop and ask' when a country isn't on either Step 2 candidate list — direct self-contradiction risking either a skipped required confirmation or a broken batch run.

Reply-format rules ('Received: N' per message) were written for an interactive per-message paste workflow, but the step auto-processes a pre-generated file — produces a garbled per-item reply stream instead of one consolidated report.

Unlike steps 2, 4, 5, and 6 which all guard with 'check whether [prerequisite] exists, stop and tell me if not', step3 has no existence guard for cf-step2's candidate list outputs and would fail ungracefully if they're missing.

Sponsorship scoring checks whether 'Salary Calculator figures... already exist elsewhere in this conversation' — relies on conversation memory instead of a persisted workspace file, contradicting step6's explicit 'not conversation memory' rule and the pipeline's own file-based state convention. Silently no-ops on a resumed session.

'Do not calculate total years of experience unless the resume states it directly. If you must derive it from dates, show the calculation' reads as self-contradictory in isolation, even though the Output Format section later clarifies the intent.
Same contradiction as CF step4 (f-0011/f-0012): framed as automated ('no user input is needed') but instructed to 'stop and explain'/'stop and state' per malformed or incomplete block.

Step3/step4 Opus branches only say 'use the deep-reasoner/calculator subagent' with no mention of which prompt file to read, unlike step5 which explicitly names its file — subagents have no conversation access to infer it.

Step5's career-ladder drafting logic is substantial business logic written directly into the orchestrator instead of a step file under prompts/salary-calculator/, breaking the 'thin orchestrator' convention followed everywhere else — even though the reason (must run before subagent handoff) is legitimate.
Two separate 'Exclude' lists in the same file partially overlap (both list FAANG-only and US-skewed data) — redundant, could be one list.

'Years-of-experience gaps are not hard blockers' is immediately followed by 'mark 🚫 only if the JD states a hard minimum and the gap is large' — self-contradicts and drifts from CLAUDE.md's explicit domain rule that years-of-experience must never be a 🚫 blocker.
'Unknown/unverifiable requirements are not blockers' is restated four separate times (Apply criterion, CONS section, MISSING INFORMATION section, closing Rules block) instead of stated once.

The 'Important' section omits the 'if a step file tells you to stop and wait, actually stop and wait' and 'do not skip or summarize' guardrails that sibling commands/portal-finder.md includes — unexplained inconsistency between two otherwise-parallel single-step orchestrators.

'Use exactly these group labels' is followed by an escape hatch for a portal fitting none of the five groups, but the output-order instruction ('in order from group 1 to 5') never says where that extra group belongs.

Description only mentions country-discovery and salary calculation, omitting portal-finder and job-screener — undersells the plugin in the marketplace listing; README's own table lists all four commands.
Identical stale description as plugin.json (same two-of-four-command omission) — must be updated together with it.
The exclude list omits Rakefile, unlike Gemfile/Gemfile.lock which are correctly excluded — confirmed by an actual build that Rakefile leaks into the public _site/ output.

gem "just-the-docs" is likely redundant since _config.yml loads the theme via remote_theme + jekyll-remote-theme; keeping both bloats the dependency list without a clear purpose. Needs a build check before removal.

Missing a '## Stop conditions' section that its three sibling overview pages (country-finder.md, salary-calculator.md, portal-finder.md) all have, despite job-screener having clear wait/stop behavior described in prose.

docs/commands/country-finder.md and docs/commands/salary-calculator.md lack the '## Usage' section that portal-finder.md and job-screener.md both include, making the four pipeline overview pages structurally inconsistent. While fixing this, also found and corrected both pages' Stop conditions ingestion description, left stale by this session's f-0011/f-0012/f-0016 fixes.

Sponsorship scoring rules reference 'Salary Calculator figures' as an evaluated input, but the 'What it reads' list never lists any Salary Calculator output file as a source — depends on f-0014 landing first so the doc describes real (file-based) reading behavior.

This page (and step3-research-prompt-generator.md, and salary-calculator steps 1/3/4/5) folds stop/completion behavior into the '## Output' section's prose instead of using the dedicated '## Stop condition' heading used by sibling step pages (CF step1/4/5/6, SC step2) — inconsistent structure across 6 files.
